brief.claim: The drug improves motor coordination: the mean time spent on the rotarod is longer in the treatment group than in the control group, and a two-tailed two-sample t test of the difference between the two group means gives p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: time in seconds that each rat stayed on the rotarod on each of the consecutive test days
whether the rat was in the treatment group (true) or the control group (false)

brief.sizes: rats = 10; days = 3 (latency: 10 x 3 = 30 values; treated: 10 values)
